title: Curriculum Learning for Generative Flexible Docking
abstract: arXiv:2610.28145v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Flexible docking is a highly practical task, aiming to predict the joint configuration of a protein-ligand complex from a protein apo structure and a ligand SMILES string. Diffusion and flow-based generative models have made this task tractable by modeling the posterior distribution over the ligand pose and the protein conformation conditioned on the apo input. The central challenge, however, remains the long-tailed apo-to-holo structure shift, where a small fraction of protein undergo large conformational changes. In this work, motivated by the practical observation that downweighting large shift examples improves generalization, and by the mixed nature of the long tail consisting of genuinely difficult examples and noisy ones, we propose to use curriculum learning for this task, gradually incorporating large conformational change examples during training. translated_title: 生成式柔性对接的课程学习
translated_abstract: 柔性对接是一项非常实用的任务，旨在根据蛋白质的失活（apo）结构和配体的SMILES字符串，预测蛋白质-配体复合物的联合构象。基于扩散模型和流模型的生成式方法通过对配体位姿和蛋白质构象在apo输入条件下的后验分布进行建模，使这一任务变得可行。然而，核心挑战依然是从apo到holo结构的长尾分布偏移问题，即少部分蛋白质会发生较大的构象变化。在这项工作中，受到以下实际观察的启发——降低大偏移样本的权重可以提升泛化能力，以及长尾样本由真正困难的样本和噪声样本混合构成的特性——我们提出在该任务中使用课程学习，在训练过程中逐步引入大构象变化的样本。通过线性进度函数，我们证明了一种现有方法可以得到显著增强。
tldr: 该论文提出将课程学习应用于生成式柔性对接任务，在训练中逐步引入大构象变化样本，以应对从apo到holo结构的长尾分布偏移这一核心挑战，从而显著提升现有生成式对接方法的性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes applying curriculum learning to generative flexible docking by gradually incorporating large conformational change examples during training, addressing the central challenge of long-tailed apo-to-holo structure shift and strongly enhancing existing generative docking methods.
